events.title: Inflation surges, PCE shows. Fed pause on rate hikes unlikely to last long with prices still rising.
events.blurb: Even though the Federal Reserve temporarily put its inflation fight on hold this week, the cost of living rose sharply again last month in a sign the central bank’s work is far from done.
